rules.accepted_credit_types: Nevada-approved courses and conferences (listed in CE Broker; APTA and APTA Nevada courses also approved; licensees may submit other courses for ACCC review via CE Broker), max 14 CCUs; Advanced Competency (ABPTS specialist exam, accredited residency or fellowship) up to 14 CCUs; Professional Activities max 8 CCUs (Board/APTA NV meetings, committee work, college coursework, in-services, pro-bono service, clinical instructor 1 CCU per 40 h, peer-reviewed publication 8 CCUs, teaching, mentorship, advocacy). 1 CCU = 1 hour; 1 CEU = 10 hours.
rules.audit_note: Documentation of all CCU activities is uploaded/reported in CE Broker during renewal; CE Broker reports to the Board's licensee portal.

topics.who: All licensees: 1 CCU on Cultural, Access, and Ethical Standards (DEI) each renewal year, counted within the 15 CCUs (effective January 1, 2025)
Nevada Jurisprudence Exam (NVJAM), free open-book, completed annually inside the renewal in the licensee portal

rules.notes: Annual renewal (up to 60 days before expiration); 15 CCUs within the year immediately preceding the renewal application, for PTs and PTAs alike. All approved courses are valid for both PT and PTA.
